newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DAF TRUCKS SAYS CAN COMPETE BETTER WITHIN PACCAR.
newsitem.headline: DAF TRUCKS SAYS CAN COMPETE BETTER WITHIN PACCAR.

text.p: DAF Trucks said on Friday its takeover by U.S. truck maker Paccar Inc meant it would be able to compete better with its European rivals.
DAF Trucks said earlier on Friday Paccar had completed its friendly 933 million guilder takeover by acquiring 100 percent of DAF Trucks' shares.

"We're in a broader structure, meaning that we can better compete with our rivals in Europe. A lot of them have said DAF was too small to survive and they will have problems, so don't buy DAF trucks. Being embedded in Paccar Inc there is no more reason to say that," DAF Trucks spokesman Henk Momber said.

"There's a weak market in Europe, we do hope that this partnership will strengthen our business, and that through that we might have better opportunities for sales," Momber said shortly after the completion news.
Momber said figures on Friday from Renault showing a ten percent fall in its commercial vehicles division showed the scale of the problems faced in the European truck market.

He said DAF Trucks was in seventh position in the European truck market behind Germany's Mercedes-Benz AG , Sweden's Volvo Truck , Renault of France , Italy's Iveco , MAN AG of Germany and Scania of Sweden.
"I think you could say the DAF brand name is strengthened through the union with Paccar," he said.
